units.locator: Article 22. General Principles of Remuneration of Municipal Servants
units.text: Article 22. General Principles of Remuneration of Municipal Servants
units.label: Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. General Principles of Remuneration of Municipal Servants
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is paid monetary remuneration consisting of an official salary corresponding to the municipal service position held (hereinafter referred to as the official salary), together with monthly and other additional payments determined by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. General Principles of Remuneration of Municipal Servants
units.text: 2. Local self-government bodies independently determine the amount and conditions of municipal servants’ remuneration. The amount of the official salary, the amounts of monthly and other additional payments, and the procedure for making those payments are established by municipal legal acts issued by the municipality’s representative body in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation and the legislation of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 22. General Principles of Remuneration of Municipal Servants
units.text: 3. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 182-ФЗ of 27.10.2008.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 22

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.label: Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 1. A municipal servant is guaranteed:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 1) working conditions that enable performance of official duties in accordance with the job description;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 2) the right to receive monetary remuneration on time and in full;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 3) rest, ensured through standard working (service) hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid leave;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 4) medical care for the municipal servant and members of the servant’s family, including after the servant retires;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 5) pension provision for length of service and disability, and pension provision for the municipal servant’s family members if the servant dies in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 6) compulsory state insurance against harm to the municipal servant’s health or property in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 7) compulsory state social insurance against illness or loss of capacity for work during municipal service or after its termination, where these arise in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 8) protection of the municipal servant and the servant’s family members against violence, threats and other unlawful acts connected with the performance of official duties, in the cases, according to the procedure and on the conditions established by federal laws.
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 2. When an employment contract with a municipal servant is terminated because a local self-government body is dissolved or its staff is reduced, the servant is provided with the guarantees established by labor legislation for employees dismissed because an organization is dissolved or its staff is reduced.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Guarantees Provided to Municipal Servants
units.text: 3. Laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the municipality’s charter may provide additional guarantees to municipal servants.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 24. Pension Provision for a Municipal Servant and Members of the Servant’s Family
units.text: Article 24. Pension Provision for a Municipal Servant and Members of the Servant’s Family
units.label: Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Pension Provision for a Municipal Servant and Members of the Servant’s Family
units.text: 1. In the area of pension provision, all rights of a state civil servant established by federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation apply in full to a municipal servant.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Pension Provision for a Municipal Servant and Members of the Servant’s Family
units.text: 2. The amount of a municipal servant’s state pension is determined in accordance with the correspondence between municipal service positions and state civil service positions of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation established by a law of that constituent entity. The maximum amount of a municipal servant’s state pension may not exceed the maximum state pension of a state civil servant of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in the corresponding state civil service position of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Pension Provision for a Municipal Servant and Members of the Servant’s Family
units.text: 3. If a municipal servant dies in connection with the performance of official duties, including after leaving municipal service, the deceased servant’s family members are entitled to a survivor’s pension according to the procedure determined by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.label: Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 1. The length (total duration) of municipal service includes periods of holding:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 1) municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 2) municipal offices;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 3) state offices of the Russian Federation and state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 4) state civil service positions, military positions, and positions in other types of federal state service;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 5) other positions in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 2. For the purpose of determining the duration of additional annual paid leave for length of service and establishing other guarantees for municipal servants provided for by federal laws, laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and charters of municipalities, the length of municipal service includes (credits), in addition to the periods of holding positions specified in part 1 of this Article, periods of holding positions included (credited) in the length of state civil service under part 2 of Article 54 of Federal Law No. 79-ФЗ of 27 July 2004 ‘On State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 3. For the award of a length-of-service pension to municipal servants, the length of municipal service includes (credits), in addition to the periods of holding positions specified in part 1 of this Article, other periods in accordance with normative legal acts of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and municipal legal acts.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Length of Municipal Service
units.text: 4. The procedure for calculating length of municipal service is established by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 26. Incentives for Municipal Servants
units.text: Article 26. Incentives for Municipal Servants
units.label: Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Incentives for Municipal Servants
units.text: The types of incentives for a municipal servant and the procedure for applying them are established by municipal legal acts in accordance with federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Art. 26 · text

units.locator: Article 27. Disciplinary Liability of Municipal Servants
units.text: Article 27. Disciplinary Liability of Municipal Servants
units.label: Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Disciplinary Liability of Municipal Servants
units.text: 1. For a disciplinary offense, namely a municipal servant’s culpable failure to perform or improper performance of the service duties assigned to them, the employer’s representative (employer) is entitled to impose the following disciplinary penalties:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Disciplinary Liability of Municipal Servants
units.text: 1) an admonition;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Disciplinary Liability of Municipal Servants
units.text: 2) a reprimand;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Disciplinary Liability of Municipal Servants
units.text: 3) dismissal from municipal service on the relevant grounds.
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Disciplinary Liability of Municipal Servants
units.text: 2. A municipal servant who has committed a disciplinary offense may be temporarily suspended from official duties, for no more than one month, pending a decision on disciplinary liability, with retention of monetary remuneration. Such suspension from official duties is effected by a municipal legal act.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Disciplinary Liability of Municipal Servants
units.text: 3. The procedure for imposing and removing disciplinary penalties is determined by labor legislation, except in cases provided for by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.label: Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 1. A municipal servant’s failure to observe restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to fulfill duties established for combating corruption by this Federal Law, Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other federal laws, is subject to the penalties provided for by Article 27 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 1.1. A municipal servant is exempt from liability for failure to observe restrictions, prohibitions or requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest, or to fulfill duties established by this Federal Law and other federal laws for combating corruption, if such failure is recognized as resulting from circumstances beyond the servant’s control according to the procedure provided for by parts 3–6 of Article 13 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 2. A municipal servant is subject to dismissal from municipal service due to loss of trust in cases of offenses established by Articles 14.1 and 15 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 3. The penalties provided for by Articles 14.1, 15 and 27 of this Federal Law are imposed by the employer’s representative (employer), according to the procedure established by normative legal acts of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and/or municipal normative legal acts, on the basis of:
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 1) a report on the results of a verification conducted by the unit for prevention of corruption and other offenses within the personnel service of the relevant municipal body, or by the authorized unit of the Executive Office of the President of the Russian Federation in accordance with Article 13.4 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’;
units.label: Point 1 Part 3 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 2) a recommendation of the commission on compliance with requirements for municipal servants’ official conduct and resolution of conflicts of interest, if the verification report was referred to that commission;
units.label: Point 2 Part 3 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 2.1) a report by the unit for prevention of corruption and other offenses within the personnel service of the relevant municipal body on the commission of a corruption offense, setting out its factual circumstances, and the municipal servant’s written explanation, only with the servant’s consent and provided that the servant admits having committed the corruption offense (except where the penalty is dismissal due to loss of trust);
units.label: Point 2.1 Part 3 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 3) explanations provided by the municipal servant;
units.label: Point 3 Part 3 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 4) other materials.
units.label: Point 4 Part 3 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 4. When imposing the penalties provided for by Articles 14.1, 15 and 27 of this Federal Law, account shall be taken of the nature and gravity of the corruption offense committed by the municipal servant, the circumstances in which it was committed, the servant’s observance of other restrictions, prohibitions and requirements to prevent or resolve conflicts of interest and fulfillment of duties established to combat corruption, and the servant’s previous performance of official duties.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 5. An act imposing a penalty on a municipal servant for a corruption offense shall specify part 1 or part 2 of this Article as the basis for imposing the penalty.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 6. The penalties provided for by Articles 14.1, 15 and 27 of this Federal Law shall be imposed no later than six months after information about the municipal servant’s corruption offense is received, excluding periods of temporary incapacity for work and leave, and no later than three years after the offense was committed. The duration of criminal proceedings is excluded from those time limits.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 27.1. Penalties for Failure to Observe Restrictions, Prohibitions and Requirements to Prevent or Resolve Conflicts of Interest, and for Failure to Perform Duties Established to Combat Corruption
units.text: 7. The local self-government body in which a municipal servant served shall enter information on the imposition of dismissal due to loss of trust on that servant in the register of persons dismissed due to loss of trust provided for by Article 15 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 27.1

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.label: Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: Personnel work in a municipality includes:
units.label: Art. 28 · “Personnel work in a municipality includes:”

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 1) developing the workforce to fill municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 2) preparing proposals for implementing municipal service legislation and submitting those proposals to the employer’s representative (employer);
units.label: Point 2 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 3) organizing the preparation of draft municipal legal acts connected with entry into and performance of municipal service, conclusion of an employment agreement (contract), appointment to a municipal service position, release from the municipal service position held, dismissal from municipal service and retirement, and preparing the corresponding documents;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 4) maintaining municipal servants’ employment record books, where available, compiling information on their employment activity during municipal service, and submitting that information according to the procedure established by Russian Federation legislation on individual (personalized) record-keeping in the compulsory pension insurance system for storage in the information resources of the Pension and Social Insurance Fund of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 5) maintaining municipal servants’ personal files;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 6) maintaining the register of municipal servants in the municipality;
units.label: Point 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Personnel Work in a Municipality
units.text: 7) preparing and issuing municipal servants’ official identity cards;
units.label: Point 7 Art. 28
